theme: Apple TFM alignment and WinUI fix
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM alignment and fixes a WinUI Projection DLL resolution failure.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI failed to locate the WinUI Projection DLL under .NET 9 due to a path resolution change introduced in that SDK. The lookup is now corrected.

bullets.lead: Apple platform TFMs aligned to SDK conventions
bullets.detail: Library TFMs are updated to version 26.0 and app TFMs use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions and fixing TFM mismatch warnings for consumers building against iOS 26 / macOS 26.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library TFM and unversioned app TFM alignment from the v4 line to the 3.119.x servicing branch.
